description: Write the instructions for an assistant that keeps its rules: a ChatGPT custom GPT, a Claude Project, a Gemini Gem, a Microsoft Copilot agent or an app's system prompt. From what it is for and who will use it, it finds the tasks it will do in the repository and what each needs, picks the protections those users call for (scope, no promises the facts do not allow, no personal data, confirmation before acting, instructions a message cannot change), and returns the instructions, a name and description, first messages, files to attach, tools to switch on and five test requests.

actions.description: It can take actions through tools.

handoff.description: Optional: how people reach a person when it cannot help.

knowledge.description: Optional facts it should answer from, such as policies or prices.

never.description: Optional: what it must never do, one per line.

platform.description: Where it will live; api means a system prompt for an app.

purpose.description: What the assistant should do, in a sentence.

name: build_assistant

jobs.description: The repository tasks it will do, for a team assistant.

platform.description: The platform and the names of its fields.

settings.description: Tools to switch on or off and why.

topics.description: What people will ask about, for a customer assistant.

title: Build a custom GPT, Claude Project or Gem
